note: Subject-class taxonomy for the stock library (brief docs/briefs/stock-library-builder.md §4). This file is DATA, not code: adding a class must never require a code change. Every class needs at least one entry in `queries`. `editorial` records the SUBJECT-not-EVENT constraint for that class and is read by humans during curation, not by the acquire script.

classes.label: Ports
classes.editorial: Infrastructure only. Never a port that reads as the specific port in the story.

classes.label: Ships
classes.editorial: Generic vessels. No identifiable hull markings or company liveries where avoidable.

classes.label: Flag — China
classes.editorial: Cutaway only. A flag stands for the state as subject, never for an event.

classes.label: Data centre
classes.editorial: Racks and aisles. No operator faces, no on-screen customer branding.

classes.label: Chip fabrication
classes.editorial: Cleanroom and wafer detail. Suited figures are fine only when unidentifiable.

classes.label: Trading floor / markets
classes.editorial: Screens and tickers. NO identifiable faces (brief §4). Never a chart a viewer could read as this story's data.

classes.label: Rocket launch
classes.editorial: Generic launch imagery. Never a launch a viewer could mistake for the specific one in the story.

classes.label: Parliament / government buildings
classes.editorial: Exteriors, and chambers only when empty or wide (brief §4). No identifiable politicians.

classes.label: Courtroom
classes.editorial: Exteriors and bench/gavel detail. NO identifiable people (brief §4).

classes.label: Construction
classes.editorial: Sites and cranes. No identifiable workers in focus.

classes.label: Abstract beds
classes.editorial: Slow texture loops to sit behind type. Must carry no subject a viewer could read as content.
